semantics.access: original authenticated-session possession and current historical disclosure policy
semantics.authorization: original session possession plus current self-user historical disclosure policy; not executable session authority
semantics.event_semantics: Original code-free phone-verification correlation observes or reconciles only the retained consuming command. Committed and not-committed terminal history are metadata observations after current disclosure authorization; unknown stays unknown. No phone projection, code comparison or attempt debit, SMS resend, new verification, session or credential delivery. Cookie transport requires exact Origin and the original stored-session synchronizer after identifier authority changes. Recovery uses verification IP admission only, never another challenge debit.

definition.name: VerificationRecoveryRequest
definition.representation: Opaque constructor-only handle; the fields describe the explicit VerificationRecoveryRequestSpec projection, not automatic JSON.

fields.name: TenantID
fields.semantics: Exact original tenant from trusted transport resolution, agreeing with recovery custody.

fields.name: UserID
fields.semantics: Original self subject authenticated by actual source-session possession, never claimed JSON.

fields.name: Caller
fields.semantics: Trusted current self-user historical disclosure action/policy; original command fields do not grant authority.

fields.name: Flow
fields.semantics: Exact original authenticated-session ID and token possession; not renewed executable session authority.

fields.name: Recovery
fields.semantics: Opaque original send/consuming command, attempt, fingerprint generation, expected version and scope/digest-key correlation. No submitted code.

fields.name: CSRFToken
fields.semantics: Current request synchronizer required by selected cookie mode. Zero is structural input only for explicitly selected bearer mode; neither source nor storage supplies a replacement.

definition.name: VerificationResult
definition.representation: Opaque result with explicit VerificationResultSpec projection. Zero accompanies a failure without authenticated observed history.

fields.name: Binding
fields.semantics: Exact original consuming command and tenant/user/action/record correlation, never a replacement.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.semantics: Original observed durability. Live leases may remain in progress; unavailable reconciliation remains unknown, never fabricated rollback.

fields.name: Identifier
fields.semantics: Always zero during recovery, including committed history.

fields.name: Recovery
fields.semantics: Unchanged original code-free correlation, not code-comparison or retry authority.

fields.name: Replayed
fields.semantics: True for an authenticated historical observation, not fresh verification.

fields.name: RetryAfter
fields.semantics: Bounded original pending receipt delay. No automatic retry or replacement attempt.

variants.semantics: Malformed or cross-scope original recovery request.
Original possession, current synchronizer or current historical disclosure authority denies. Withhold result on post-query disclosure withdrawal.
Original retained command/attempt scope conflicts; never adopt new correlation.
Original outcome remains unknown with authenticated unchanged recovery custody.
Bounded native storage/custody/cancellation failure; never infer rollback, repeat comparison or issue credentials.
